# EIP-Labs

> EIP-Labs is the Research and Development laboratory of EIP-Technologies. We engineer typed AI engines, compiled AI engines, and deterministic AI engines in pure Go for autonomous enterprise systems.

EIP-Labs builds foundational AI infrastructure: AgentOS microkernels, distributed state fabrics, and a high-assurance enterprise agentic engine. Mission is dependable, cost-effective, safe autonomy for mission-critical environments.

## Primary topics

- Typed AI engine: static types constrain agent state, tools, and messages at compile time.
- Compiled AI engine: single zero-CGO Go binary; reproducible builds; cloud, edge, and air-gapped deployability.
- Deterministic AI engine: predictable concurrency, bounded allocation, auditable agent state transitions.
- Go AI engine: pure Go agent runtime for high agent density without Python wrapper chains.
- Alternatives: AI framework alternatives, AI system alternatives, AI platform alternatives, AI project alternatives — especially vs Python-centric stacks (LangChain/CrewAI-style wrappers).
